notes:
Account summary: large industrial automation vendor moving AI features (operator assistance, real-time quality control) to hosted+dedicated mix. Procurement for dedicated pool for latency-sensitive inference. Key ask: legally binding throughput guarantees (min tokens/sec) + clear concurrency caps and burst policy. Customer quote: "We need predictable throughput during morning shifts; spikes up to 3x for 10-15 min are common."

Main negotiation points:
- Minimum sustained guarantee: 120,000 tokens/sec across dedicated pool (requested). Redwood initial proposal: 90,000 tokens/sec with 15% burst allowance. Customer pushing for 120k sustained or credits.
- Concurrency caps: want 300 concurrent short-chat sessions (avg 60 tokens/response) + 50 high-throughput batch reranking jobs. Propose soft caps with graceful queueing.
- Burst policy: ability to burst up to 250% of sustained for 10m windows, 2x/day. Redwood prefers 150% burst for 5m unless pre-warmed GPUs.
- Latency SLOs: p95 <= 250ms for 64-token responses; p99 <= 800ms. Also require p95 <= 350ms for 256-token responses.
- Reserved GPU planning: target 8x H100-equivalent; pool must support KV cache warm-up, prefix caching across customers, option to pin model variants. Autoscale floor at dedicated nodes; burst pool from shared capacity subject to credits.
- Fallbacks & routing: require routing policy that favors lower-cost model variant when load high but must preserve prioritized SLAs for critical routes.
- Quantization: acceptable up to 4-bit for non-critical features; core quality flows require FP16.
- Security/compliance: data residency in US-East required for production, SOC2 report required, SSO via Okta mandatory, customer-managed KMS for private deployment.

Sales touches: AE (Alex Park) + SE (Priya) have run three deep technical calls. Legal looped in Feb; procurement coordinating budget cycle (Apr target). CSM Jon introduced for rollout planning.

POC plan: 3-week POC (week1 perf baseline, week2 stress + concurrency tests, week3 SLA runbook and failover drills). Success metric: sustain 110k tokens/sec for 30 continuous minutes with p95 targets met and <1% error rate.

Notes snippets (shorthand):
- "need credits for missed throughput"
- "can pre-pay burst allowance"
- "require 4hr MTTR on critical incidents"
- "on-prem install window Q3 if private accepted"
